propositions: Jira rich-text and comment-limit modules are loaded by literal lazy-load keys in backend-neutral core paths (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py), coupling vendor code to any backend
outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py must route through port roles (FieldSanitizer.fit_comment and InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text) and delete all literal adapters.jira lazy-key references
FieldSanitizer gains fit_comment(body: str) -> str for pure comment-diff truncation without send-side warnings, delegating to comment_limits.truncate_comment_body
InboundMapper gains normalize_rich_text(body: Any) -> str to decode vendor rich-text (ADF for Jira, identity for strings) backend-neutrally on both inbound apply and outbound diff paths
inbound_translate._normalize_adf_body stays as a public function re-implemented to route through the port; applier.py stops re-exporting the deleted vendor internals
A test sweep must verify no package-root core module (except inbound_fields.py with recorded exemption) contains the literal 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira'
